verdict.rationale: Probes confirm that a live llms.txt exists at docs.helicone.ai/llms.txt and indexes the documentation as markdown links. Individual doc pages are also served as .md files that point agents back to that index, and an OpenAPI swagger.json is available. This is hands-on proof of agent-oriented docs, beyond a vendor claim. Missing for 10: no first-party documentation describing the llms.txt/agent-docs offering (such as an llms-full.txt or usage guidance), and no independent user corroboration of agents consuming it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
